company_overview: Postman is an API platform that simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration to help teams build better APIs faster. The platform is used by millions of developers and over 500,000 companies, including 98% of the Fortune 500, to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs at scale.
target_audience: Engineering teams, developers, and API professionals in enterprises seeking to streamline API development, testing, and collaboration.
leadership_names: Abhinav Asthana; Ankit Sobti; Abhijit Kane

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Postgres development platform that provides a managed PostgreSQL database along with authentication, APIs, edge functions, realtime capabilities, storage, and vector embeddings. It enables developers to build and scale applications quickly while offering enterprise-grade security, compliance, and integration features.
target_audience: Developers and product teams building AI-driven applications who need a production-ready Postgres backend with authentication, APIs, edge functions, and compliance, including innovation teams and enterprises seeking to accelerate prototyping and scale to millions of users.

company_overview: Vapi provides a platform for building, deploying, and improving voice AI agents quickly and at scale. It offers unified orchestration, real-time monitoring, enterprise-grade configurability, and integrations that let developers go from prompt to production fast.
target_audience: Vapi's ideal customers are developers and enterprises that need to build, deploy, and scale voice AI agents, serving industries such as automotive, healthcare, marketplace, freight, and insurance.
